why: I checked the output for expect lines and proof entries. It has none, because it answers "blocked": it says issue #11 "is a question" and "does not ask for any change to the repository." Since there are no expect lines, none of them can depend on a release, a deploy, a published page or anything else that exists only after merge. None can be ambiguous to check at the PR head either. Blocking is also the right call: the request only asks why mathlib uses CommonJS, so there is nothing to build or verify. The criterion therefore holds for the whole output, although only because there is nothing in it to fail.
